scripts.bindings: for p in caravel-repo caravel-oracle; do (cd ../packages/$p && npm install --no-audit --no-fund --silent && npm run build --silent) || exit 1; done
scripts.build:public: VITE_DEMO_SIGNER= npm run build && node scripts/check-no-secrets.mjs
scripts.build:pages: npm run build:public && node scripts/build-pages.mjs && node scripts/check-no-secrets.mjs ../dist-pages
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build:pages && npx -y wrangler@4 pages deploy ../dist-pages --project-name ${PAGES_PROJECT:-caravel-repo} --branch main --commit-dirty=true
